design: Athletic adult female Yautja guard, alien anatomy without human face or sexualized body. Ash-white speckled hide and exposed four mandibles, angular tapered forehead, many thin waist-length dreadlocks with dark stone beads. Reinforced bronze-rimmed dark segmented cuirass, single angular right shoulder plate, black layered leather waist panels and practical thigh armor. Left hand holds a small rounded elongated bronze-black shield vertically beside the leg, right hand relaxed at a sheathed short curved blade. Weight gently on rear foot.
